pages.text: Requires Applied Energistics 2 and the libraries its Forge release requires, including GuideME for the tested release. ME Conduits connect compatible parts of an AE2 network through a conduit bundle.

Use six Conduit Binders in the top and bottom rows of a crafting grid and three AE2 Glass Cables in the middle row to make three ME Conduits. Use Covered Dense Cable in the middle for three Dense ME Conduits.
Run the conduit between a powered ME network and your device. Normal conduits carry up to eight channels and Dense ME Conduits up to 32. Check every connecting segment and the AE2 channel settings.
Use the connection color controls where available. A disabled connection or incompatible cable color can split the grid. Start with one terminal or drive on a known powered route, then expand it.
